name: -12 AN Male to -16 AN Female Reducer Union
title: -12 AN Male to -16 AN Female Reducer Union
description:
The -12 AN Male to -16 AN Female Reducer Union is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Male to AN Female Reducer Union Fittings are precision-engineered to connect and transition between different AN flare sizes, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each adapter is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings’ proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. These fittings are designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments commonly found in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

the AN Male to AN Female Reducer Union Fittings are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with the nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference the installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
